title: lagopsis supina
intro: Lagopsis supina, commonly known as the white-flowered lagopsis, is a perennial plant species in the mint family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Lagopsis supina include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce fever, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
